Specification: This specification models a very small state machine with a single boolean-like state variable, error. The initial state requires error = FALSE, and the next-state action assigns error' = FALSE on every step, so the system keeps the variable fixed to FALSE forever. The specification also defines an invariant Inv asserting that it is not the case that error = TRUE, expressing the intended safety property that the error state is never reached.
